correctness.rationale: The published natural Świątkowski comparison (Theorem 4.5 and Proposition 4.9) applies to the continuous unordered space. The independent reconstruction gives C3 of rank 9120, C2 of rank 22800, 54720 nonzeros in the signed top boundary, and C4=0 by weight. Independence of the 9099 non-free columns modulo 3 gives rational independence; the 21 exact integral cycles with identity free coordinates then span the full integral kernel, by subtracting those coordinates. Reconstruction also checks all 1456 simple cycles and exactly 20 disjoint triples, all hexagons. The loop difference sums are primitive weight-one cycles; on the disjoint union of the three circles their signed tensor represents the three-torus fundamental class, and graph-embedding naturality gives its image in D. The exact torus-coordinate minor after deleting row 7 is +1, proving the split primitive rank-20 inclusion, not only rational independence. Mod 2 top nullity is 26; universal coefficients therefore give five factors of order two in H2[2], without fixing exponents of cyclic two-primary summands.
residual_risks: The exact rank check is for the reduced chain model; continuity and geometric cycle identification use the published comparison and functoriality, not numerical testing.
The order-two subgroup is determined, not all integral H2 or the orders of its two-primary cyclic summands.

The primitive codimension-one deficit distinguishes all such products from the full integral lattice, rather than just adding one more graph Betti number; the exact order-two subgroup also constrains possible lower-degree integral calculations.
